item.tib: gsang chen seng ge sgra sgrogs las mchod pa'i rgyan phreng lha dbang dgyes pa'i pad mo
item.coloph: de ltar gsang chen seng ge sgra sgrogs kyi mchod pa'i rgyan phreng lha dbang dgyes pa'i pad mo zhes bya ba 'di yang gzhung gzhan dang rigs mthun du kho bo shar rdza'i rgyal tshab blo gros rgya mtsho ming pas dkyus thog gcig tu glog gi gar mkhan ltar bris pa dge legs 'phel//
